reviews.body: Thanks for your PR! 💖  I think I also want SESSION_ID to be changed to a getter as well, instead of having the `typeof window` check as paths that need the session ID should either fail hard, or create a proper session id, and not fallback to `''` if `typeof window === 'undefined'` so I'll have my agent make a PR exploring that approach and may choose to merge that instead 🙌
